name: Pattern breakout
idea: A signal on the first close beyond a flag, a pennant or a converging triangle; the idea has ended when the close is back inside the pattern.

params.label: The pattern
params.help: Which consolidation the break comes out of.

params.label: Volume expansion
params.help: The breakout bar's volume must be at least this many times the average (0 means no volume condition; indices have no volume).

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the pattern the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level that says the breakout failed: the far side of the pattern, just beyond the broken edge, or the middle of the pattern.
choice_labels: The far side of the pattern

params.label: Edge buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the broken edge': how many average true ranges beyond it.
